refnamediv.refpurpose: Reset all options of a libcurl session handle

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
voidcurl_reset CurlHandlehandle
This function re-initializes all options set on the given cURL handle to the default values, except for live connections, the session ID cache, the DNS cache, cookies, shares and the alt-svc cache: a cookie acquired before calling this function, whether from CURLOPT_COOKIEFILE, a Set-Cookie response header, or a CurlShareHandle with CURL_LOCK_DATA_COOKIE, is still sent afterwards, until an explicit CURLOPT_COOKIELIST => "ALL" or the handle is destroyed.
Calling this function on a handle that is still attached to a CurlMultiHandle and being actively driven by curl_multi_exec silently abandons the transfer: no exception or warning is raised at the point of the call, but the multi stack later reports CURLE_GOT_NOTHING for that handle once read via curl_multi_info_read. This differs from an ordinary curl_setopt call made mid-transfer, which does not disrupt it.

&reftitle.notes;
curl_reset also resets the URL given as the curl_init parameter.
